data.name: Psionic Trip
data.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a trip combat maneuver, you also deal %1 damage to the creature tripped.  If you expend your psionic focus when you perform a successful trip combat maneuver, you can also throw your target up to %2 ft., although the creature thrown may not be more than one size category larger than you.|PsionicTripDamage|PsionicTripDistance
